notes: Search budget spent (8 of 8). Fetches 16 of 60. Only one NJ organizer has its own pages in this sweep: S&B Sports Collectibles (sbsportspromotions.com schedule and contact pages), which gave two records. Those dates come from the organizer schedule: the page footer says 2026 and no year sits beside each date, so confidence is medium. Both dates pass a Friday to Sunday weekday check. The organizer schedule has no hours, table counts, admission or vendor application link, so none are recorded. A treasurehunter listing says Nov 6 to 7 for Vineland and the organizer says Nov 6 to 8, so the organizer's dates are used. Organizer-page candidates NOT yet found for most leads: Old Bridge Elks series, Hightstown Engine Co. No. 1, Colts Neck, Jersey City Evolving TCG, Newark DE Ramada shows, Diamond State (New Castle), Delaware Card Show, Nutley, Exit 117, Manahawkin, Lindenwold. Guessed organizer domains did not resolve: ourcardsandcollectibles.com, hightstownfire.com, hightstownengine.com, coltsneckfire.com, diamondstatecardshow.com, evolvingtcg.com. Nur Shrine Center site (nurshrine.org) lists no card show but gives the venue address. Ramada Newark page on wyndhamhotels.com did not show the event. Out of region, noted for the PA sweep and not recorded here: the same S&B schedule lists Montgomery Mall in North Wales PA Oct 30 to Nov 1 2026, Oxford Valley Mall in Langhorne PA Nov 13 to 15 2026, and Berkshire Mall in Wyomissing PA Nov 20 to 22 2026. Coverage of Delaware is thin: no DE organizer page was found. Run ended early only because the 8 search cap was reached, not by choice. Wilmington Collectibles Show at Elks Lodge 532 (Wilmington DE, Jul 11 2026, past) appeared only in a search snippet with no verifiable URL, so it is not listed.
